query:
DELETE ph FROM priceHistory ph
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT 
    cardId, source, grade, jpyPrice,
    MIN(soldAt) as keep_soldAt,
    MIN(id) as keep_id
  FROM priceHistory
  WHERE source = 'snkrdunk' AND jpyPrice IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cardId, source, grade, jpyPrice
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    AND DATEDIFF(MAX(soldAt), MIN(soldAt)) <= 7
) keep_table ON (
  ph.cardId = keep_table.cardId
  AND ph.source = keep_table.source
  AND (ph.grade = keep_table.grade OR (ph.grade IS NULL AND keep_table.grade IS NULL))
  AND ph.jpyPrice = keep_table.jpyPrice
)
WHERE ph.id != keep_table.keep_id
  AND ABS(DATEDIFF(ph.soldAt, keep_table.keep_soldAt)) <= 7;
